title: Anne Hathaway's 2026 Film Slate Includes Thriller and Flop
summary: Actress Anne Hathaway's 2026 film slate includes the dark thriller "Verity," co-starring Dakota Johnson. While Hathaway is described as continuing a "dream run" with the film, one of her other 2026 projects was politely admitted by the actress to be a flop. The trailer for "Verity" has been released.
